players.product: glass thinning / etching (TGV) for glass-core substrates

quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue KRW 349,824,883,850; operating profit KRW 17,441,716,150; net income KRW 9,712,038,921

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 segment mix: semiconductor (PGMEA and other semiconductor materials, glass-substrate TGV processing, silicon/glass wafer processing) KRW 42,384M (12.1%), up from KRW 17,369,869 thousand in H1 2025 (segment pre-tax profit KRW 1,617,097 thousand vs KRW 3,253,024 thousand); electronics (TV/appliance modules, wireless charging, OLED glass etching) KRW 196,830M (56.3%); automotive electronics KRW 21,671M (6.2%); chemical distribution and other KRW 88,940M (25.4%)

Glass substrates: the company has secured laser drilling and wet-etching technology for TGV (through-glass via) and is building a 'One Path Line' that runs laser, wet etching, AOI inspection, plating and CMP in-house so it can produce and ship finished glass substrates; TGV/TTV development ongoing since 2023.08; plans to extend TGV to display and camera-sensor uses. It also expects the glass carrier wafer market to grow with HBM packaging, supporting its wafer-processing business (subsidiary J3, acquired January 2025); glass-wafer ONO-removal polishing under development 2026.05-2026.10

Semiconductor-grade PGMEA (5N 99.999% purity, for photoresist including EUV and for cleaning thinner): purification capacity of 25,000 tons a year completed in May 2025; the company says supply to global customers is ramping and expects semiconductor-materials revenue growth to accelerate with EUV adoption. H1 2026 capacity: semiconductor materials and chemicals 44,014 tons (production 11,779 tons); wafer processing 356K ea (production 266K ea); electronics and automotive parts 54,236K ea (production 27,083K ea)
quarterly_data.figure: PGMEA capacity 25,000 tons/year; H1 chemicals production 11,779 tons vs capacity 44,014 tons

quarterly_data.signal: Suppliers: PGMEA / MDG raw materials are bought from Dow, Lyondell, Eastman, Hannong Chemical and Lotte Chemical (average purchase price KRW 1,486 in H1 2026 vs KRW 1,273 in FY2025); H1 raw-material purchases KRW 80,372M for semiconductor and distribution, KRW 131,396M for electronics and automotive. Chemical distribution customers named: Dongjin Semichem, LG Chem, Dongwoo Fine-Chem, KCC and Samhwa Paint
